analisis_rubro_aplica.description: one short line: which of the two fields is in scope for this document's line of business, and whether that specific datum appears printed anywhere in the text

cantidad_comensales_personas.description: the number of diners, only when the line of business is Restaurante; otherwise 'null'. Exactly as printed, without the unit; 'null' when it is not printed — never deduced from the number of items

cantidad_litros.description: the litres, only when the line of business is Combustible; otherwise 'null'. Exactly as printed, without the unit; 'null' when it is not printed — never deduced from the amount divided by the price
